text:
Nora (People Ops): Dropping a tiny pack of next-gen goal templates for managers + ICs. Aim: speed up handoffs and make self-reviews one-click. Short ask: quick review?

Ravi (Eng Manager): skimmed. Can we have a variant that forces a single measurable success metric? helps calibration.

Nora (People Ops): yup — added a mandatory 'Primary success metric' line and an optional 'signal list' for supporting KPIs.

Jenna (IC): please include a 1-sentence 'why this matters' for every goal. it's great for onboarding new hires.

Nora (People Ops): done. also made a "Dual-team" micro-template: 

```
Goal (1-line):
Why (1-sentence):
Primary success metric:
Owners: (primary / co-owner)
Estimated weekly focus: 0-100%
Blockers/help needed:
```

Kai (Product): add an example for exploratory work (no clear metric) — e.g., "run 3 experiments and produce decision doc"

Nora (People Ops): added three exploratory patterns: deliverable, learning milestone, decision gate. Example included.

TemplateBot: Note: Resource update queued; templates will appear in the Self-Review Hub within 24 hrs.

Ravi (Eng Manager): can peer feedback be 3 bullets max? we want 30-60s reviews.

Nora (People Ops): micro-peer prompts: 
- One-line outcome observed
- One suggestion to amplify impact
- One quick ask/offer to help next quarter
Optional: "Stop doing" prompt for calibration.

Jenna (IC): perfect. any guidance for managers accepting goals?

Nora (People Ops): small manager acceptance checklist included: outcome-oriented, measurable OR defined milestone, owners clear, time commitment reasonable. yes/no ticks.

Ravi (Eng Manager): great. drop in #docs and ping managers. I'll run a pulse check next week. :thumbsup:

Nora (People Ops): will do — uploading PDF + paste-ready TL;DR for calendar invites. Thanks all!
